mapper.insert: insert into dc_stray_animal(stray_no, stray_category, stray_name, stray_age, stray_gender, stray_neuter, stray_weight, stray_character, stray_memo, stray_status, stray_notice_no, stray_notice_start, stray_notice_end, stray_found_place, stray_shelter_name, stray_shelter_tel, stray_shelter_addr, stray_img) values(#{stray_no},#{stray_category},#{stray_name},#{stray_age},#{stray_gender}, #{stray_neuter},#{stray_weight},#{stray_character},#{stray_memo},#{stray_status}, #{stray_notice_no},#{stray_notice_start},#{stray_notice_end},#{stray_found_place},#{stray_shelter_name}, #{stray_shelter_tel},#{stray_shelter_addr},#{stray_img})
mapper.select: select * from dc_stray_animal where stray_category = #{stray_category} order by DBMS_RANDOM.VALUE FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY
mapper.update: update dc_stray_animal set stray_category = #{stray_category}, stray_name = #{stray_name}, stray_gender = #{stray_gender}, stray_neuter = #{stray_neuter}, stray_weight = #{stray_weight}, stray_character = #{stray_character}, stray_memo = #{stray_memo}, stray_status = #{stray_status}, stray_shelter_name = #{stray_shelter_name}, stray_shelter_tel = #{stray_shelter_tel}, stray_shelter_addr = #{stray_shelter_addr}, stray_img = #{stray_img} where stray_no = #{stray_no}
